name: Oathfire Quartermaster
rationale: A low-spark Warrior turns a fallen ally into immediate energy, suggesting a battlefield officer who burns vows and bodies into one more surge.

name: Echo-Toll Savant
rationale: The character makes every event harder to cast but doubles its consequence, like a scholar who charges a toll for awakening an echo.

name: Candlewake Augur
rationale: A tiny early character reads each event's afterimage, turning every spell into a small glimpse of the deck's next path.

name: Sevenfold Voidling
rationale: A harmless one-cost presence becomes awakened and dangerous only when the void is deep enough to complete its hidden count.

name: Gloamdoor Executioner
rationale: This mid-cost character arrives through a dark threshold and immediately dissolves a small enemy, making the entrance itself the killing stroke.

name: Snap the Waking Thread
rationale: A cheap fast interrupt cleanly dissolves a modest character at the decisive instant, like severing the thread that lets a dream hold shape.

name: Ashhand Ascendant
rationale: This small body grows whenever cards are cast into the void, presenting a survivor of discarded possibilities gaining strength from each loss.

name: Mistmarket Usher
rationale: A veiled one-cost character quietly shelters cheap arrivals and refunds energy, evoking a hidden guide who moves small allies through secret stalls.
